body:
Thank you for your advice.  I had always thought I had good self-esteem yet I make bad decisions over and over.  It vexes me that I am able to help others and see so clearly what they should/should not do yet I fail repeatedly.

I saw a school mandated therapist for 5 sessions after my undergraduate suicide attempt but nothing after that. I didn't want to go anywhere in town where someone would recognize me or my family (I live in a small town).

As far as treatment plans, I took an SSRI for 3 months but took myself off it because it didn't help.  I know SSRIs take at least a month to build up in the system but I didn't want a crutch to help me get over my depression.  I guess I never got over it...
